turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer from Pune?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Maam, I am Rohan from the International Logistics Hub. We have a parcel for you held at customs because the documentation is incomplete.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Parcel? I am not expecting anything from outside. Is there some mistake?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is marked as a high-value gift, maam. If you do not clear the customs holding today, the government will impose a legal penalty on your address.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Penalty? Please tell me what I have to do, I do not want any trouble.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You just need to pay a clearance fee of nine thousand five hundred rupees to release the shipment immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That is a lot of money. Can I come to the office and pay it in person?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, the warehouse is restricted. I will send you a UPI link right now, or you can buy a Google Play gift card and tell me the code.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Gift card for customs? I have never heard of this before.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the new digital process, Mrs. Iyer. Please hurry or the parcel will be seized by the police by evening.
